findings.finding: Medium levels of syncopation elicit the highest ratings of wanting to move and experience pleasure.
findings.quote: the results showed that medium degrees of syncopation elicited the most desire to move and the most pleasure

findings.finding: High-groove music modulates and increases activity within the motor system.
findings.quote: These results indicate that high-groove music increasingly engages the motor system

findings.finding: The temporal qualities of music, including its pulse and rhythmic patterns, drive the universal urge to move.
findings.quote: it is usually the temporal qualities of the music-its pulse, tempo, and rhythmic patterns-that put them in this state.

principle: Medium degrees of syncopation and high-groove music engage the motor system and elicit the strongest desire to move and experience pleasure.
for_the_teacher: Use music with medium syncopation and strong groove elements to naturally elicit a desire to move in learners.
